rule.water_pixel: seasons/s2_MM.tif: NDWI (NIR from red and NDVI) > 0 or NIR < 0.04, not bright (water_seasons.py)
rule.water: per 20 m pixel max(frequency, fraction): frequency = wet months / observed (>= 3); fraction = its NDWI's 75th percentile over the clear months unmixed between the never-wet land within 300 m and the tile's always-wet water (median NDWI; 0.3 with under 10 such pixels); DEM slope < 0.2, DEM > 0.5 m; bilinear onto the 5 m grid, water at >= 0.5
rule.naip: imagery/naip.tif is RGB (no NIR band): not used
rule.reach: on: water within max(w/2, 10 m); near: within max(60 m, 2 w); every 10 m; on water >= 0.6, off water: near >= 0.5, else no water seen
rule.move: stems of DEM reaches with width >= 10 m not on water: least-cost path on the 5 m grid within 600 m of the drawn stem on ground <= 10 m over its nearest DEM line cell (water 1 + 2 exp(-d_in/6 m), land 12 x (0.4 + 0.6 min(1, d_dem/30 m))), edge ends fixed, interior ends snapped to water within 60 m, a junction on a moved stem taken as moved, smoothed 10 m; kept when on >= 0.5 and >= the old line's + 0.2; the reaches meeting a moved node bent to it over 2 |shift| + 20 m (shift <= 30 m) or extended straight to it (one per node)
rule.nhd_dropped: NHD-sourced stretches with width >= 10 m, no water seen, within 600 m of a moved stem's old or new line, off the tile edge: the map's pieces of a river where the imagery shows none
rule.width: a moved reach takes the water's median cross-section when >= 40 m and wider than drawn
rule.side_channels: the river's water within 250 m, off the moved ribbon (w/2 + 10 m), its skeleton's longest path >= 150 m: a reach at its measured width (source imagery)
rule.undrawn: water patches >= 1600 m2 beyond w/2 + 20 m of every reach and 20 m of every kept pond
